I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the deadline for the signed order form at Thornbury Cloth Co. is 21 December.

Marcus posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and Dana is a member of that channel. It's a deadline, not a money figure, so it was fine to share there. Nothing in the channel has changed the date since. There are no Thornbury files in the share, so I couldn't check the date against a document, and I told her that too.
